# Solving 3x + 7 = 22

## Goal
Isolate x on one side of the equation to find its value.

## Steps

1. Subtract 7 from both sides — undo the +7 to get the 3x term alone
   3x + 7 − 7 = 22 − 7
   3x = 15

2. Divide both sides by 3 — undo the ×3 to get x by itself
   3x / 3 = 15 / 3
   x = 5

## Watch Out
Whatever you do to one side of the equation, you MUST do to the other side. Never change just one side — that breaks the balance.

## Try This
Solve: 4x − 3 = 13

---
Answer: x = 5
